english: Raised Bed
xhosa_before: Ibhedi ephakanyisiweyo
back_translation: Raised bed

english: Keyhole Bed
xhosa_before: Ibhedi yembobo yesitshixo
back_translation: Keyhole bed

english: Herb Spiral
xhosa_before: Uzungulo lwamayeza
back_translation: Cycle of herbs/medicines (herb spiral?)
note: Uzungulo = cycle/circuit; the spiral shape is not named, so it can read as a rotation of herbs. Name of a placed element, no instruction depends on it. Left for a fluent reviewer.

english: Tree Basin
xhosa_before: Ibheseni yomthi
back_translation: Tree basin

english: Vegetable Bed
xhosa_before: Ibhedi yemifuno
back_translation: Vegetable bed

english: Other Tree
xhosa_before: Omnye umthi
back_translation: Another tree

english: Indigenous Shade Tree
xhosa_before: Umthi wesithunzi wemveli
back_translation: Traditional shade tree

english: Other planting
xhosa_before: Ezinye izityalo
back_translation: Other crops

english: Pollinator Strip
xhosa_before: Umgca wezinambuzane ezixhaphazayo
back_translation: Line of exploiting/harassing insects
note: "ezixhaphazayo" read as exploiting/harassing insects, i.e. pests, for pollinators. The rest of the locale says pollination as "ukuthwalwa komungu wentyatyambo" (g24). Now "insects that carry pollen".

english: Beds & strips
xhosa_before: Iibhedi nemigca
back_translation: Beds and lines

english: Indigenous fruit
xhosa_before: Iziqhamo zemveli
back_translation: Traditional fruits

english: Fruit & nut trees
xhosa_before: Imithi yeziqhamo neyamantongomane
back_translation: Fruit and nut trees

english: Shade & other trees
xhosa_before: Imithi yesithunzi neminye imithi
back_translation: Shade trees and other trees

english: Windbreaks
xhosa_before: Izikhuseli zomoya
back_translation: Windbreaks

english: Staple garden
xhosa_before: Igadi yokutya okuphambili
back_translation: Staple-food garden

english: Fit map to view
xhosa_before: Lungisa imephu ukuze ibonakale yonke
back_translation: Adjust the map so that all of it is visible

english: Base: {mode}. Switch base.
xhosa_before: Isiseko: {mode}. Tshintsha isiseko.
back_translation: Base: {mode}. Change the base.

english: Base: {mode}. Switch to {next}.
xhosa_before: Isiseko: {mode}. Tshintshela ku-{next}.
back_translation: Base: {mode}. Switch to {next}.

english: satellite
xhosa_before: isathelayithi
back_translation: satellite

english: photo
xhosa_before: ifoto
back_translation: photo

english: drone photo
xhosa_before: ifoto ye-drone
back_translation: drone photo

english: blank
xhosa_before: ize
back_translation: empty

english: Site not analysed yet — open this place on the map to fetch climate & slope, then redraw.
xhosa_before: Indawo ayihlalutywanga okwangoku — vula le ndawo kwimephu ukuze kufumaneke imozulu nethambeka, uze uphinde uzobe.
back_translation: The site has not been analysed yet — open this site on the map so weather and slope become available, then draw again.

english: No terrain data yet — open this place on the map to fetch slope & aspect.
xhosa_before: Akukho datha yomhlaba okwangoku — vula le ndawo kwimephu ukuze kufumaneke ithambeka nesalathiso salo.
back_translation: No land data yet — open this site on the map so slope and its direction become available.
note: "isalathiso salo" (its pointer/indicator) for slope aspect is loose; readable. Left.

english: No wind/temperature data yet — open this place on the map to fetch climate.
xhosa_before: Akukho datha yomoya/yobushushu okwangoku — vula le ndawo kwimephu ukuze kufumaneke imozulu.
back_translation: No wind/temperature data yet — open this site on the map so weather becomes available.

english: No regional fire-wind pattern for this area — walk the boundary and ask neighbours which side fires come from.
xhosa_before: Akukho ndlela yomoya womlilo yengingqi kule ndawo — hamba ujikeleze umda uze ubuze abamelwane ukuba imililo ivela kweliphi icala.
back_translation: No regional fire-wind direction for this site — walk around the boundary and ask neighbours from which side the fires come.

english: Fire sector not shown: this site’s fire season doesn’t match the region’s sourced berg-wind pattern — confirm the fire approach locally before siting a firebreak.
xhosa_before: Icala lomlilo alibonisiwe: ixesha lomlilo kule ndawo alihambelani nendlela yomoya we-berg yengingqi eyaziwayo — qinisekisa apho umlilo ufika khona kwindawo yakho ngaphambi kokubeka isithintelo somlilo.
back_translation: Fire side not shown: the fire season at this site does not match the known regional berg-wind direction — confirm where fire reaches your site before placing a firebreak.

english: Cold air settles in low spots on still, clear nights.
xhosa_before: Umoya obandayo uhlala kwiindawo eziphantsi ebusuku obuzolileyo, obucacileyo.
back_translation: Cold air stays in the low places on still, clear nights.

english: Local DEM relief is too small to confirm a downhill direction — use neighbouring contours or measure the fall on site.
xhosa_before: Ukuphakama komhlaba kwe-DEM yalapha kuncinci kakhulu ukuqinisekisa icala elihla — sebenzisa imigca yokuphakama ekufutshane okanye ulinganise ukuhla kwendawo.
back_translation: The ground height of the local DEM is too small to confirm the downhill direction — use nearby contour lines or measure the slope of the place.

english: Already traced your fence line on the main map? You’re done. Otherwise tap "Do this" and trace the outer edge of your land here, corner to corner.
xhosa_before: Sele uwuzobile umgca wocingo wakho kwimephu ephambili? Ugqibile. Ukuba akunjalo, cofa "Yenza oku" uze uzobe umphetho wangaphandle womhlaba wakho apha, ikona ngekona.
back_translation: Have you already drawn your fence-wire line on the main map? Done. If not, click "Do this" and draw the outer edge of your land here, corner by corner.
note: "umgca wocingo" is the fence-wire line; the sense (trace your boundary) is intact. Left.

english: The outer edge of your land, corner to corner.
xhosa_before: Umphetho wangaphandle womhlaba wakho, ikona ngekona.
back_translation: The outer edge of your land, corner by corner.

english: Mark your house
xhosa_before: Phawula indlu yakho
back_translation: Mark your house

english: Tap "Do this", then trace around your house roof on the map.
xhosa_before: Cofa "Yenza oku", uze uzobe ujikeleze uphahla lwendlu yakho kwimephu.
back_translation: Click "Do this", then draw around the roof of your house on the map.

english: The building you live in — tanks and Zone 1 go closest to it.
xhosa_before: Isakhiwo ohlala kuso — iitanki noMmandla 1 zibekwa kufuphi nayo.
back_translation: The building you live in — tanks and Zone 1 are placed near it.

english: Mark paving & driveway
xhosa_before: Phawula ipeyivingi nendlela yokungena yemoto
back_translation: Mark paving and the vehicle entrance

english: Trace hard surfaces — the driveway, yard paving, or a concrete slab.
xhosa_before: Zoba iindawo ezomeleleyo — indlela yokungena yemoto, ipeyivingi yegceke, okanye ibhulokhi yekhonkrithi.
back_translation: Draw the hard areas — vehicle entrance, yard paving, or a concrete block.

english: Anywhere rain runs straight off instead of soaking in.
xhosa_before: Naphi na apho imvula ibaleka ngokukhawuleza endaweni yokufunxwa ngumhlaba.
back_translation: Wherever rain runs off quickly instead of being absorbed by the ground.

english: Mark existing lawn, veg or orchard
xhosa_before: Phawula ingca, imifuno okanye ingadi yeziqhamo esele ikhona
back_translation: Mark existing grass, vegetables or orchard

english: Trace the ground you already use — a lawn, an old veg patch, existing trees.
xhosa_before: Zoba umhlaba osele uwusebenzisa — ingca, isiqwenga semifuno esidala, imithi esele ikhona.
back_translation: Draw the land you already use — grass, an old vegetable patch, existing trees.

english: What’s already growing, so your plan builds on it.
xhosa_before: Oko sele kukhula, ukuze isicwangciso sakho sakhelwe kuko.
back_translation: What is already growing, so your plan is built on it.

english: Find the sun arc — your beds want the northern sun
xhosa_before: Fumana isiphaluka selanga — iibhedi zakho zifuna ilanga elisemantla
back_translation: Find the sun arc — your beds need north sun

english: The gold arc across the top of the map is the sun. In South Africa it swings across the NORTH, so that side gets the most light.
xhosa_before: Isiphaluka segolide phezulu kwemephu lilanga. KuMzantsi Afrika lijikeleza ngaseMNTLA, ngoko elo cala lifumana ukukhanya okuninzi.
back_translation: The golden arc at the top of the map is the sun. In South Africa it swings toward the NORTH, so that side gets the most light.

english: Face your veg beds and tender crops toward the sun side — the north.
xhosa_before: Jongisa iibhedi zakho zemifuno nezityalo ezibuthathaka ngakwicala lelanga — emntla.
back_translation: Face your vegetable beds and tender crops toward the sun side — north.

english: Note the fire wedge — plan a firebreak/low fuel on that side
xhosa_before: Qaphela unxantathu womlilo — cwangcisa isithintelo somlilo okanye izinto ezivuthayo ezimbalwa kwelo cala
back_translation: Notice the fire triangle — plan a firebreak or few flammable things on that side

english: The red wedge points to where a veld fire is most likely to come from — the dry-season wind. If it is missing, your site has no wind data yet.
xhosa_before: Unxantathu obomvu ubonisa apho umlilo wasendle unokuvela khona — umoya wexesha elomileyo. Ukuba awukho, indawo yakho ayinayo idatha yomoya okwangoku.
back_translation: The red triangle shows where wildfire could come from — the dry-season wind. If it is absent, your place has no wind data yet.

english: Keep a firebreak clear and the fuel low on the fire side of your land.
xhosa_before: Gcina isithintelo somlilo sicocekile kwaye izinto ezivuthayo zimbalwa kwicala lomlilo lomhlaba wakho.
back_translation: Keep the firebreak clear and few flammable things on the fire side of your land.

english: See the downhill water arrow — swales will go ACROSS it
xhosa_before: Bona utolo lwamanzi ehla — imisele iya kuwela NGAPHESHEYA kwalo
back_translation: See the water arrow going down — swales will cross ACROSS it

english: The blue arrow shows which way water runs downhill. Swales and beds work best laid ACROSS that flow, not along it, so rain sinks in.
xhosa_before: Utolo oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lubonisa ukuba amanzi ehla ngaliphi icala. Imisele neebhedi zisebenza kakuhle zibekwe NGAPHESHEYA koko kuhamba, kungekhona ngokulandelana nako, ukuze imvula ingene emhlabeni.
back_translation: The sky-blue arrow shows which way water goes down. Swales and beds work well placed ACROSS what flows, not along it, so rain soaks into the ground.

english: Later, on the Water step, draw your swale lines across this arrow.
xhosa_before: Kamva, kwinyathelo lamanzi, zoba imigca yemisele yakho ngaphesheya kwalo tolo.
back_translation: Later, at the water step, draw your swale lines across that arrow.

english: Add your rainwater tanks
xhosa_before: Yongeza iitanki zakho zamanzi emvula
back_translation: Add your rainwater tanks

english: Tap a JoJo tank size, then tap the map next to a roof.
xhosa_before: Cofa ubungakanani beetanki ye-JoJo, uze ucofe imephu ecaleni kophahla.
back_translation: Click the JoJo tank sizes, then click the map beside the roof.

english: Within 3 m of a roof downpipe, on level, compacted ground.
xhosa_before: Ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-3 kwipayipi yophahla, emhlabeni olinganayo onyanyekileyo.
back_translation: Within 3 metres of the roof pipe, on level, firm ground.

english: Mark your tap points
xhosa_before: Phawula iindawo zakho zethepi
back_translation: Mark your tap places

english: Tap "Do this", then drop a tap point wherever you’ll fill a can or hose.
xhosa_before: Cofa "Yenza oku", uze ubeke indawo yethepi naphi na apho uza kuzalisa khona ikani okanye umbhobho.
back_translation: Click "Do this", then place a tap place wherever you will fill a can or pipe.

english: At bed corners — so a hose reaches without crossing a path.
xhosa_before: Kwiikona zebhedi — ukuze umbhobho ufike ungawuweli indlela.
back_translation: At bed corners — so the pipe arrives without crossing the path.

english: Draw swale lines across the slope
xhosa_before: Zoba imigca yemisele ngaphesheya kwethambeka
back_translation: Draw swale lines across the slope

english: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (on contour), not down it, so rain sinks in.
xhosa_before: Zoba umgca NGAPHESHEYA kwethambeka (ngokwemigca yokuphakama), kungekhona ukuhla nalo, ukuze imvula ingene emhlabeni.
back_translation: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (along the contour lines), not down it, so rain soaks into the ground.

english: Along the hillside, level end to end — above your beds and trees.
xhosa_before: Ecaleni kwenduli, uthe tye ukusuka kwesinye isiphelo ukuya kwesinye — ngaphezulu kweebhedi nemithi yakho.
back_translation: On the hillside, straight from one end to the other — above your beds and trees.
xhosa_after: Ecaleni kwenduli, ngokulinganayo ukusuka kwesinye isiphelo ukuya kwesinye — ngaphezulu kweebhedi nemithi yakho.
note: "level end to end" read as "straight from one end to the other"; "uthe tye" means horizontal/straight, so the level (on-contour) condition of a swale was lost. The row also says "above your beds". Now "ngokulinganayo" (levelly), the same root as "olinganayo" used for level ground in rows 52 and 70.

english: Add drip or pipe lines
xhosa_before: Yongeza imigca yokuconsa okanye yemibhobho
back_translation: Add drip lines or pipes

english: Draw where water will travel — a drip line to the beds or a pipe from a tank.
xhosa_before: Zoba apho amanzi aya kuhamba khona — umgca wokuconsa oya kwiibhedi okanye umbhobho ovela kwitanki.
back_translation: Draw where water will go — a drip line going to the beds or a pipe from the tank.

english: Tank → beds, the shortest sensible run.
xhosa_before: Itanki → iibhedi, indlela emfutshane enengqiqo.
back_translation: Tank → beds, the shortest sensible way.

english: Add a pond or greywater basin
xhosa_before: Yongeza ichibi okanye ibheseni ye-greywater
back_translation: Add a pond or greywater basin

english: Optional: a pond in a low spot, or a greywater basin off the kitchen outlet.
xhosa_before: Akunyanzelekanga: ichibi kwindawo ephantsi, okanye ibheseni ye-greywater evela kwindawo yokuphuma yekhitshi.
back_translation: Optional: a pond in a low place, or a greywater basin from the kitchen outlet.

english: Ponds in a natural low point; greywater by a fruit tree or banana.
xhosa_before: Amachibi kwindawo ephantsi yendalo; i-greywater ecaleni komthi wesithelo okanye webhanana.
back_translation: Ponds at a natural low place; greywater beside a fruit tree or banana.

english: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (on contour), not down it, so rain sinks in. Turn Contours on in Layers to see the lines to follow.
xhosa_before: Zoba umgca NGAPHESHEYA kwethambeka (ngokwemigca yokuphakama), kungekhona ukuhla nalo, ukuze imvula ingene emhlabeni. Vula Imigca yokuphakama kwiileyile ukubona imigca ekufuneka uyilandele.
back_translation: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (along the contour lines), not down it, so rain soaks into the ground. Open Contour lines in layers to see the lines to follow.

english: Build the berm on the downhill side
xhosa_before: Akha induli yomhlaba kwicala elihla
back_translation: Build a mound of earth on the downhill side

english: The soil you dig out of a swale goes on its downhill lip. Place a berm there, then plant it.
xhosa_before: Umhlaba owombulayo emseleni ubekwa kumphetho wawo ohla. Beka induli yomhlaba apho, uze uyityale.
back_translation: Soil dug out of the swale is put on its downhill edge. Put a berm of earth there and plant it.

english: Directly below each swale — never above it.
xhosa_before: Ngqo ngezantsi kwawo wonke umsele — ungaze ube ngaphezulu kwawo.
back_translation: Directly below every swale — never above it.

english: Terrace the steep ground
xhosa_before: Yenza iiteresi emhlabeni otyekeleyo
back_translation: Make terraces on tilted ground

english: On a slope too steep to plant across, cut level platforms with a bank between them.
xhosa_before: Kwithambeka elityekele kakhulu ukuba utyale ngaphesheya kwalo, sika iiqonga ezilinganayo zineebhanki phakathi kwazo.
back_translation: On a slope too tilted to plant across, cut level platforms with banks between them.

english: The steepest part of your land, where soil washes away now.
xhosa_before: Inxalenye etyekele kakhulu yomhlaba wakho, apho umhlaba ukhukuliswa ngoku.
back_translation: The very tilted part of your land, where soil is currently being eroded.

english: Add half-moons for single trees
xhosa_before: Yongeza iziqingatha zenyanga kwimithi emnye-mnye
back_translation: Add half-moons for single trees

english: A half-moon is a small crescent bank that catches runoff for one tree. Good where a full swale is more digging than you need.
xhosa_before: Isiqingatha senyanga yibhanki encinci egobileyo ebamba amanzi ageleyo emthini omnye. Isebenza kakuhle apho umsele opheleleyo ufuna ukugrumba okungaphezu kwalokho kufunekayo.
back_translation: A half-moon is a small curved bank that holds the water running down at a single tree. It works well where a whole swale needs more digging than is required.

english: Uphill of a tree you want to keep alive through the dry season.
xhosa_before: Ngaphezulu komthi ofuna ukuwugcina uphila ngexesha elomileyo.
back_translation: Above the tree you want to keep alive in the dry season.
note: "Uphill of" read as "above the tree"; in a slope hint this is understood as upslope. Left.

english: Zone 1 — nearest the kitchen door
xhosa_before: Ummandla 1 — osondele kakhulu kumnyango wekhitshi
back_translation: Zone 1 — closest to the kitchen door

english: Paint the area you can reach in about 20 steps from the door.
xhosa_before: Pentela indawo onokuyifikelela ngamanyathelo angama-20 ukusuka emnyango.
back_translation: Paint the area you can reach in 20 steps from the door.
note: "about 20 steps" read as "20 steps" ("about" lost); harmless. Left.

english: Right around the house — herbs, salad, the things you pick daily.
xhosa_before: Ngqo ejikeleze indlu — amayeza, isaladi, izinto ozikha yonke imihla.
back_translation: Directly around the house — herbs, salad, things you pick every day.
note: "amayeza" is medicines/medicinal plants; used for herbs throughout the drafts. Left.

english: Zone 2 — your main veg beds
xhosa_before: Ummandla 2 — iibhedi zakho eziphambili zemifuno
back_translation: Zone 2 — your main vegetable beds

english: Paint the next ring out — where the bulk of your vegetables grow.
xhosa_before: Pentela esinye isangqa ngaphandle — apho kukhula khona inkoliso yemifuno yakho.
back_translation: Paint another circle outside — where most of your vegetables grow.

english: A short walk from the door; visited most days.
xhosa_before: Uhambo olufutshane ukusuka emnyango; utyelelwa phantse yonke imihla.
back_translation: A short walk from the door; visited almost every day.

english: Zone 3 — orchard & food forest
xhosa_before: Ummandla 3 — ingadi yeziqhamo nehlathi lokutya
back_translation: Zone 3 — orchard and food forest

english: Paint where your fruit trees and bigger plots will live.
xhosa_before: Pentela apho imithi yakho yeziqhamo neziqwenga ezikhulu ziya kuba khona.
back_translation: Paint where your fruit trees and large plots will be.

english: Further out — visited weekly, not daily.
xhosa_before: Ngaphandle ngakumbi — kutyelelwa rhoqo ngeveki, kungekhona yonke imihla.
back_translation: Further out — visited weekly, not daily.

english: Zone 4 / 5 — grazing & wild edge
xhosa_before: Ummandla 4 / 5 — indawo yokwalusa nomphetho wasendle
back_translation: Zone 4 / 5 — grazing area and wild edge

english: Optional: paint low-care land — grazing, woodlot, or a wild buffer strip.
xhosa_before: Akunyanzelekanga: pentela umhlaba ongafuni nkathalo ininzi — indawo yokwalusa, ihlathi lenkuni, okanye umgca wasendle okhusela.
back_translation: Optional: paint land that does not want much care — grazing area, firewood forest, or a protective wild strip.

english: The outer edges you visit least.
xhosa_before: Imiphetho yangaphandle oyityelela kancinane.
back_translation: Outer edges you visit little.

english: Place your fruit & nut trees first
xhosa_before: Qala ngokubeka imithi yakho yeziqhamo neyamantongomane
back_translation: Start by placing your fruit and nut trees

english: Trees are biggest and last longest — place them, then fit beds around them.
xhosa_before: Imithi inkulu kwaye ihlala ixesha elide — yibeke kuqala, uze ulungiselele iibhedi ejikeleze yona.
back_translation: Trees are big and live long — place them first, then arrange beds around them.

english: South or west of veg beds (SA sun is in the north) so they don’t shade them. Give each its full-grown width.
xhosa_before: Emzantsi okanye entshona yeebhedi zemifuno (ilanga laseMzantsi Afrika lisemntla) ukuze ingazithunzi. Nika omnye nomnye ububanzi bokukhula ngokupheleleyo.
back_translation: South or west of the vegetable beds (South African sun is north) so it does not shade them. Give each one full growing width.

english: Add your vegetable beds
xhosa_before: Yongeza iibhedi zakho zemifuno
back_translation: Add your vegetable beds

english: Drop beds in full sun, within easy reach of a tap and the kitchen.
xhosa_before: Beka iibhedi elangeni elipheleleyo, kufuphi nethepi nekhitshi.
back_translation: Place beds in full sun, near the tap and kitchen.

english: Open, sunny ground in Zone 1–2 — not under a tree canopy.
xhosa_before: Umhlaba ovulekileyo onelanga kuMmandla 1–2 — kungekhona phantsi kwesithunzi somthi.
back_translation: Open sunny ground in Zones 1–2 — not under tree shade.

english: Add support planting
xhosa_before: Yongeza izityalo ezixhasayo
back_translation: Add supporting plants

english: Optional: pollinator strips, mulch banks, a banana circle — they feed the system.
xhosa_before: Akunyanzelekanga: imigca yezinambuzane ezixhaphazayo, iibhanki zomhlaba ogqunyiweyo, isangqa sebhanana — zondla inkqubo.
back_translation: Optional: lines of exploiting insects, mulched earth banks, a banana circle — they feed the system.
xhosa_after: Akunyanzelekanga: imigca yezinambuzane ezithwala umungu wentyatyambo, iibhanki zomhlaba ogqunyiweyo, isangqa sebhanana — zondla inkqubo.
note: Same "ezixhaphazayo" (exploiting insects) for pollinator strips. Now "izinambuzane ezithwala umungu wentyatyambo".

english: Pollinators along orchard edges; mulch banks beside the beds that need it.
xhosa_before: Izinambuzane ezixhaphazayo ecaleni kwemiphetho yengadi yeziqhamo; iibhanki zomhlaba ogqunyiweyo ecaleni kweebhedi ezizifunayo.
back_translation: Exploiting insects along the orchard edges; mulched earth banks beside beds that need them.
xhosa_after: Izinambuzane ezithwala umungu wentyatyambo ecaleni kwemiphetho yengadi yeziqhamo; iibhanki zomhlaba ogqunyiweyo ecaleni kweebhedi ezizifunayo.
note: Same "ezixhaphazayo" for pollinators. Now "izinambuzane ezithwala umungu wentyatyambo".

english: Set up compost
xhosa_before: Misela umgquba
back_translation: Set up compost

english: Place a compost bay or worm farm on the path between kitchen and beds.
xhosa_before: Beka indawo yomgquba okanye ifama yeentshulube endleleni phakathi kwekhitshi neebhedi.
back_translation: Place a compost site or worm farm on the path between kitchen and beds.

english: On the way out with scraps, on the way in with finished compost.
xhosa_before: Xa uphuma neentsalela, xa ungena nomgquba ogqityiweyo.
back_translation: On the way out with scraps, on the way in with finished compost.

english: Place animal housing
xhosa_before: Beka indawo yokuhlala yezilwanyana
back_translation: Place an animal housing spot

english: Optional: a chicken coop, kraal or pen — close enough for daily care, downwind of the house.
xhosa_before: Akunyanzelekanga: ikheyiji yeenkukhu, isibaya okanye indawo evaliweyo — kufuphi ngokwaneleyo ukuze unikele ingqalelo yonke imihla, ngaphaya komoya ukusuka endlini.
back_translation: Optional: a chicken cage, kraal or enclosed place — near enough to give attention daily, beyond the wind from the house.

english: Read the land's energies
xhosa_before: Funda amandla omhlaba wakho
back_translation: Read the energies of your land

english: Before you place a single thing, see how sun, wind, fire and water may move across your land. The app computes sun, slope, drainage and traced access for this property, and adds clearly marked regional wind and fire context. Design WITH these energies, not against them: put windbreaks against the hot wind, a firebreak on the fire side, swales across the way water runs, and keep tender crops out of frost pockets. In South Africa the strongest sun usually comes from the north. Confirm the regional wind and fire assumptions with your own observations or a local expert before you build.
xhosa_before: Phambi kokuba ubeke nanye into, jonga ukuba ilanga, umoya, umlilo namanzi kunokuhamba njani emhlabeni wakho. I-app ibala ilanga, ithambeka, ukuphuma kwamanzi nendlela zokufikelela ezizobiweyo kule ndawo, yongeza imeko yengingqi yomoya nomlilo ebhalwe ngokucacileyo. Yila NGAMANDLA la, hayi ngokuwaphikisa: beka izikhuseli zomoya ngakwicala lomoya oshushu, isithintelo somlilo ngakwicala lomlilo, imisele ngaphesheya kwendlela edlula kuyo amanzi, uze ugcine izityalo ezithambileyo kude neendawo ezibanjwa ngumkhenkce. EMzantsi Afrika, ilanga elinamandla kakhulu liqhele ukuvela emantla. Qinisekisa iingcinga zengingqi ngomoya nomlilo ngokuziqwalaselela ngokwakho okanye ngengcali yasekuhlaleni phambi kokuba wakhe.
back_translation: Before you place a single thing, look at how sun, wind, fire and water might move on your land. The app calculates sun, slope, water exit and drawn access ways for this place, and adds regional wind and fire context, clearly written. Design WITH these energies, not by opposing them: put wind protectors on the hot-wind side, a firebreak on the fire side, swales ACROSS the path along which water passes, and keep tender crops away from places held by frost. In South Africa the strong sun usually comes from the north. Confirm the regional ideas about wind and fire by observing yourself or with a local expert before you build.

english: Design from patterns to details — read the big forces first, then place the small things.
xhosa_before: Yila ukusuka kwiipatheni ukuya kwiinkcukacha — funda kuqala amandla amakhulu, uze ubeke izinto ezincinci.
back_translation: Design from patterns to details — read the big forces first, then place the small things.

english: Fire comes from the dry-season wind — keep the fuel low and a firebreak clear on that side of your land.

english: Water first, everything else second
xhosa_before: Amanzi kuqala, yonke enye into yesibini
back_translation: Water first, everything else second

english: Water is the heaviest thing to move and the first thing to run out. Catch it where it falls: tanks next to roofs, and swale lines across the slope, on contour, so rain sinks into your soil instead of washing away. A garden planned around water survives a dry month; one without doesn't.
xhosa_before: Amanzi yeyona nto inzima ukuyihambisa kwaye yeyona iqala ukugqiba. Wabambe apho ewa khona: iitanki ecaleni kophahla, nemigca yemisele ngaphesheya kwethambeka, ilandela umgca wokuphakama, ukuze imvula ingene emhlabeni endaweni yokuhlanjwa. Igadi eyilelwe ngokujikeleza amanzi iyasinda enyangeni eyomileyo; engenawo ayisindi.
back_translation: Water is the heaviest thing to move and the first to run out. Catch it where it falls: tanks beside roofs, and swale lines across the slope, following the contour line, so that rain enters the soil instead of being washed away. A garden designed around water survives a dry month; one without it does not survive.

english: Catch and store energy — harvest rain in the wet season, spend it in the dry.
xhosa_before: Bamba uze ugcine amandla — vuna imvula ngexesha lemvula, uyisebenzise ngexesha elomileyo.
back_translation: Catch and store energy — harvest rain in the rainy season, use it in the dry season.

english: Place a tank within 3 m of a roof downpipe. Every 10 mm of rain on a 100 m² roof gives you about 1,000 litres.
xhosa_before: Beka itanki ngaphakathi kwe-3 m kwipayipi yophahla yokuhlisa amanzi. Yonke i-10 mm yemvula kuphahla lwe-100 m² ikunika malunga ne-1,000 yeelitha.
back_translation: Place a tank within 3 m of a roof downpipe. Every 10 mm of rain on a 100 m² roof gives you about 1,000 litres.

english: Shape the land once
xhosa_before: Lungisa umhlaba kube kanye
back_translation: Shape the land once

english: Earthworks are the slowest thing to undo, and the first thing a machine should do while it can still reach the ground: swales dug along the contour, berms built from what comes out of them, terraces and banks cut into a slope. Get the levels right and every rain afterwards works for you — water walks slowly across your land instead of running off it. Get them wrong and you have moved a great deal of soil into the wrong place.
xhosa_before: Imisebenzi yomhlaba yeyona nto ibuhlungu ukuyibuyisela umva, kwaye yeyona umatshini ofanele ukuyenza kuqala ngoxa usenokufikelela emhlabeni: imisele ebhuliweyo ilandela umgca wokuphakama, iindonga zomhlaba ezakhiwe ngomhlaba obuphuma kuyo, iitheresi neebhanki ezinqunyiwe kwithambeka. Ukuba iinqanaba zilungile, yonke imvula emva koko ikusebenzela — amanzi ahamba kancinci kwindawo yakho endaweni yokubaleka. Ukuba aliyonjalo, ubuhambise umhlaba omninzi kakhulu waya kwindawo engafanelekanga.
back_translation: Earthworks are the thing most painful to take back, and the thing a machine should do first while it can still reach the ground: swales dug following the contour line, walls of earth built with the soil that comes out of them, terraces and banks cut into the slope. If the levels are right, all rain afterwards works for you — water moves slowly across your place instead of running away. If it is not so, you have moved a great deal of soil to the wrong place.

english: Work with nature, not against it — follow the contour the land already has.
xhosa_before: Sebenza nendalo, hayi ngokuyiphikisa — landela umgca wokuphakama onawo umhlaba.
back_translation: Work with nature, not by opposing it — follow the contour line the land already has.

english: Set your levels along the contour before you dig, and plant the bank as soon as it is shaped — a bare berm is the first thing a big rain takes away.
xhosa_before: Misela iinqanaba zakho ngokulandela umgca wokuphakama phambi kokuba umbe, kwaye utyale kwibhanki kwangoko emva kokuba ibunjiwe — indonga yomhlaba engenanto itshathu yeyona nto ithathwa yimvula enkulu kuqala.
back_translation: Set your levels following the contour line before you dig, and plant on the bank immediately after it has been shaped — an earth wall with nothing [bare] is the first thing taken by heavy rain.
xhosa_after: Misela iinqanaba zakho ngokulandela umgca wokuphakama phambi kokuba umbe, kwaye utyale kwibhanki kwangoko emva kokuba ibunjiwe — indonga yomhlaba engenazityalo yeyona nto ithathwa yimvula enkulu kuqala.
note: Stray word "itshathu" after "engenanto" could not be read ("an earth wall with nothing, ?"), and "bare" is the point of the warning (an unplanted berm is washed away first). Now "indonga yomhlaba engenazityalo" (earth wall without plants). The planting instruction before it was intact.

english: Put things where your feet already go
xhosa_before: Beka izinto apho iinyawo zakho sele zihamba khona
back_translation: Put things where your feet already go

english: Zones plan your energy, not just your space. Things you visit every day — herbs, veg beds, chickens — belong nearest the kitchen door. Things you visit weekly or monthly go further out. This one idea cuts real walking time over a season, and keeps your most-tended plants where you will actually notice if they need water.
xhosa_before: Imimandla icwangcisa amandla akho, hayi nje indawo. Izinto ozindwendwela yonke imihla — amayeza, imibhede yemifuno, iinkuku — zifanele ukuba ziseduze nomnyango wekhitshi. Izinto ozindwendwela veki nganye okanye inyanga nganye ziya kude ngakumbi. Eli nqaku linye linciphisa ixesha lokuhamba kwisizini, kwaye ligcina izityalo ozinyamekela kakhulu apho uya kuqaphela khona ukuba zidinga amanzi.
back_translation: Zones plan your energy, not just a place. Things you visit every day — herbs/medicines, vegetable beds, chickens — should be close to the kitchen door. Things you visit every week or every month go further. This one point reduces walking time over a season, and keeps the plants you look after most where you will notice if they need water.

english: Zone planning — the more often you use it, the closer it lives.
xhosa_before: Ucwangciso ngemimandla — ngokuba uyisebenzisa rhoqo, iba kufuphi ngakumbi.
back_translation: Zone planning — the more often you use it, the closer it is.

english: Stand at your kitchen door and count 20 steps. What you can reach is Zone 1 — keep your daily harvest inside it.
xhosa_before: Yima emnyango wekhitshi uze ubale amanyathelo angama-20. Oko ukufikelelayo yiMimandla 1 — gcina isivuno sakho semihla ngemihla ngaphakathi kuyo.
back_translation: Stand at the kitchen door and count 20 steps. What you reach is Zone 1 — keep your daily harvest inside it.

english: Right plant, right place
xhosa_before: Isityalo esifanelekileyo, kwindawo efanelekileyo
back_translation: The right plant in the right place

english: Trees are the biggest, longest-living things you'll place — position them first and fit beds around them. In South Africa the midday sun sits in the north, so a tall tree on the north side of a bed steals its light. Give every fruit tree room for its full-grown size, not its seedling size.
xhosa_before: Imithi zezona zinto zinkulu nezihlala ixesha elide ozibekayo — yibeke kuqala uze ulungise imibhede ejikeleze yona. EMzantsi Afrika ilanga lasemini likumntla, ngoko umthi omde ngasemantla ebhedini uthatha ukukhanya kwayo. Nika umthi weziqhamo ngamnye indawo yobungakanani bawo obuzeleyo, hayi bobungakanani besithole.
back_translation: Trees are the biggest things and the longest-lived that you place — place it first and arrange the beds around it. In South Africa the midday sun is in the north, so a tall tree on the north side of a bed takes its light. Give each fruit tree room for its full size, not the size of a seedling.

english: Use and value diversity — a mix of trees, beds and flowers confuses pests and feeds bees.
xhosa_before: Sebenzisa uze uxabise ukwahlukahlukana — umxube wemithi, imibhede neentyatyambo ubhidanisa izinambuzane ezonakalisayo kwaye wondla iinyosi.
back_translation: Use and value diversity — a mix of trees, beds and flowers confuses harmful insects and feeds the bees.

english: Plant tall trees on the south or west of veg beds so winter sun still reaches them. A mango grows 10 m wide — measure that out before you dig.
xhosa_before: Tyala imithi emide emazantsi okanye entshona yemibhede yemifuno ukuze ilanga lasebusika lisafikelela kuyo. I-mango ikhula ibe ngama-10 m ububanzi — linganisa oko phambi kokuba umbe.
back_translation: Plant tall trees to the south or west of the vegetable beds so that winter sun still reaches them. A mango grows to 10 m width — measure that out before you dig.

english: Buildings must work for the land
xhosa_before: Izakhiwo mazisebenzele umhlaba
back_translation: Buildings must work for the land

english: Sheds, coops and kraals are workers, not furniture: a roof catches water, a wall blocks wind, animals make manure for your compost. Place each structure where what it produces feeds the next thing along.
xhosa_before: Iindlu zokugcina izixhobo, iindlu zeenkuku nezibaya ngabasebenzi, ayizizo izinto zokuhombisa: uphahla lubamba amanzi, udonga luthintela umoya, izilwanyana zenza umanyolo womgquba wakho. Beka isakhiwo ngasinye apho oko sikuvelisayo kondla into elandelayo.
back_translation: Storage houses for tools, chicken houses and kraals are workers, they are not decorations: a roof catches water, a wall blocks wind, animals make manure for your compost. Place each structure where what it produces feeds the next thing.

english: Integrate rather than segregate — place things so they help each other.
xhosa_before: Hlanganisa kunokwahlula — beka izinto ukuze zincedisane.
back_translation: Combine rather than separate — place things so that they help each other.

english: Put the compost bay on the path between kitchen and veg beds — scraps in on the way out, finished compost back on the way in.
xhosa_before: Beka indawo yomgquba kwindlela phakathi kwekhitshi nemibhede yemifuno — inkunkuma yokutya ingena xa uphuma, umgquba ogqityiweyo ubuye xa ubuya.
back_translation: Place the compost place on the path between kitchen and vegetable beds — kitchen scraps go in when you go out, finished compost comes back when you come back.

english: Look before you build
xhosa_before: Jonga phambi kokuba wakhe
back_translation: Look before you build

english: Walk through your design like a real morning: fetch water, feed the chickens, pick spinach. Are the paths short? Does anything shade the beds or block the tap? Changing it on the map costs nothing — changing it after digging costs a season.
xhosa_before: Hamba kuyilo lwakho njengomso wokwenyani: zisa amanzi, ondla iinkuku, khetha isipinatshi. Ingaba iindlela zimfutshane? Ingaba kukho into enika imibhede umthunzi okanye evala ithephu? Ukuyitshintsha kwimephu akubizi nto — ukuyitshintsha emva kokumba kubiza isizini.
back_translation: Walk through your design like a real tomorrow: bring water, feed the chickens, pick spinach. Are the paths short? Is there anything that shades the beds or blocks the tap? Changing it on the map costs nothing — changing it after digging costs a season.
note: "umso" read as "tomorrow" ("a real tomorrow") for "a real morning"; the walk-through task is the same. Left.

english: Apply self-regulation and accept feedback — check the plan before the spade hits the ground.
xhosa_before: Zilawule uze wamkele uluvo — hlola isicwangciso phambi kokuba ifosholo ithi nca emhlabeni.
back_translation: Regulate yourself and accept opinion — check the plan before the spade touches the ground.

english: Show the design to one other person. A mentor sees in one minute what you've stopped noticing.
xhosa_before: Libonise elinye umntu uyilo lwakho. Umcebisi ubona ngomzuzu omnye oko ungasakuqapheli.
back_translation: Show your design to another person. An adviser sees in one minute what you no longer notice.
